# Irish Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (IACP)

> Ireland's professional body regulating counsellors and psychotherapists through accreditation, ethics standards, and member accountability.

IACP is the leading professional association for counselling and psychotherapy in Ireland, providing member accreditation, professional standards enforcement, therapist directories, and client protection mechanisms. The organization maintains rigorous ethical codes, governance structures, and complaints procedures to ensure quality mental health services.

## Key Topics

- Professional accreditation
- Code of Ethics and Practice
- Therapist directory
- Member complaints procedure
- Pre-accredited membership
- Student membership
- Counselling and psychotherapy
- Professional standards

## Organization & Governance

- [Irish Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy](https://iacp.ie): Homepage for IACP, Ireland's professional counselling and psychotherapy association
- [About the Irish Association of Counsellors and Psychotherapists](https://iacp.ie/about-irish-association-for-psychotherapists-counsellors): IACP organizational overview, mission, and professional regulation information
- [Board of Directors and Staff](https://iacp.ie/board-of-directors-and-staff): IACP leadership structure, board members, and staff directory
- [IACP Committees](https://iacp.ie/iacp-committees): IACP committee structure and governance organization
- [IACP Regional Committees](https://iacp.ie/IACP-Regional-Committees): Regional committee structure and membership administration
- [Company Information](https://iacp.ie/iacp-company-information): IACP organizational details, structure, and company information

## Member Directory & Accreditation

- [Find a Therapist](https://iacp.ie/therapists): IACP therapist directory and accredited member search tool
- [Pre-Accredited Members Check](https://iacp.ie/preaccredited-members-list): Pre-accredited member verification and counsellor/psychotherapist search
- [Student Membership](https://iacp.ie/Student-Membership): Student membership options and training requirements for IACP
- [Pre-Accredited Membership](https://iacp.ie/Pre-Accredited-Membership): Pre-accredited membership tier and professional registration requirements

## Professional Standards & Ethics

- [Code of Ethics and Practice](https://iacp.ie/iacp-code-of-ethics-and-practice): IACP professional ethics code and practice standards for members

## Complaints & Accountability

- [Member Complaints Procedure](https://iacp.ie/complaints): IACP complaints procedure and member accountability process
- [How to Make a Complaint](https://iacp.ie/information-for-clients): Client guide to filing complaints against IACP members
- [Complaint Appeals Procedure](https://iacp.ie/appeals-procedure): Appeals process for IACP member complaints and disputes
- [Complaints Against Course Providers](https://iacp.ie/complaints-against-course-providers): Complaints procedure for training and accreditation course providers
